授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: This course will improve students’ understanding of the relationship between humans and the natural or non-human world, specifically in the areas of environmentalism and the Anthropocene. To do so, we will discuss and research these issues together and independently, with an emphasis on class discussions and presentations. By engaging with a variety of sources, students will gain familiarity with the ways in which English is employed to discuss the non-human world, and how such skills can be applied to their future careers.
